items.l1: No matter where he goes, Xiaoming takes Lanlan with him.
items.notes: Faithful; only gap is the pinyin name Lanlan (gold 蓝蓝), whose characters English cannot fix.

items.l1: They like to write out schedules very clearly, with what to do at what time all planned.
items.notes: Faithful; low score is lexical (几点 vs 什么时间), several faithful renderings.

items.l1: Communicating the schedule in advance and understanding each other's habits are what make better cooperation possible.
items.notes: Faithful incl. the 才能 condition; divergence is synonym choice only.

items.l1: People in different places see time differently.
items.notes: Literal match to 看时间不一样; back-translations just paraphrase as 看法.

items.l1: For appointments or classes, they arrive early.
items.notes: Faithful; 早早到 vs 都会早到 is a stylistic variant, score at floor.

items.l1: Some people take their time.
items.notes: Blind back-translation matched gold exactly (有的人慢慢来); reference is tight.

items.l1: Ideas about time are different, and that is okay.
items.notes: 'are fine' read as approval of each idea; gold says the difference itself is okay (没关系), so restored that two-clause focus.

items.l1: Some people write down a schedule and look at it every day.
items.notes: Faithful; 日程安排 vs 时间表 is a synonym gap.

items.l1: Some people remember things and do not write them down.
items.notes: Faithful in context; gold 不写字 is terse beginner Chinese that natural English renders as 'not write them down'.

items.l1: Now the world is connected.
items.notes: Faithful; 连在一起 vs 联系/相连 is a synonym spread.

items.l1: I take my time; do not be angry.
items.notes: Removed the added causal 'so' and 'with me'; gold is a bare juxtaposition 我慢慢来，你别生气.

items.l1: These neurons are activated when we imitate other people's behavior.
items.notes: Faithful; low score from clause order (当…时 fronted vs 会在…时 embedded).

items.l1: Because of this, real estate prices sometimes rise.
items.notes: Faithful; 房地产价格/升高 vs 房价/上涨 are synonyms.

items.l1: Since ancient times, different civilizations have tried to capture fleeting sounds with visual symbols, but early notation methods were mostly suggestive rather than precise.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's literary register (稍纵即逝, 多具…而非…) gives many equivalent renderings.

items.l1: After a few weeks, the things turn black and become smaller.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's terse 变黑变小 vs expanded back-translation.

items.l1: Viewed from an ecological perspective, the project places particular emphasis on the scientific nature of species configuration.
items.notes: Faithful; 生态学视角审视/尤为重视 vs 生态角度看/特别注重 are register-level synonyms.

items.l1: So, different notation systems appeared.
items.notes: Faithful; 'notation systems' is a standard rendering of 记谱法, gap is 记谱法 vs 记谱系统.

items.l1: In medieval Europe, an early form of line notation appeared.
items.notes: 'staff notation' pulls to 五线谱, which the next sentence (two lines at first) contradicts; gold is 线谱, so used 'line notation' and gold's fronted place-time.

items.l1: Such traditional practices are often rooted in long-term environmental observation and intergenerational transmission, and their core lies in maximizing water use efficiency while maintaining the sustainability of the ecosystem.
items.notes: Faithful, same clause order as gold; score at floor from 'while' being rendered 在…的同时.

items.l1: In some regions, the right to use water is even passed down hereditarily, and its enforcement is supervised by specialized administrators, called "water officials", to ensure fairness and order.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's parenthetical (称为水官) is source text, not a leak, and the reference correctly renders it without parentheses.

items.l1: I bought this T-shirt in a small shop.
items.notes: Blind back-translation matched gold verbatim; reference is tight, first score was noise.

items.l1: At that time I was just browsing, and I didn't expect to find such a piece of clothing that I loved.
items.notes: Faithful; 随便看看/心仪 vs 随便逛逛/喜欢 are synonyms.

items.l1: The design on this T-shirt makes me feel happy.
items.notes: Faithful; 感到快乐 vs 觉得很开心 is a synonym gap.

items.l1: Put the kitchen scraps in a box.
items.notes: 'kitchen scraps' = 厨余 and fits next sentence (leaves, peels); back-translation drift to 剩菜剩饭 was the reviewer's, not the reference's.

items.l1: Putting a small box on the balcony is enough.
items.notes: 'bin' pulls to 桶; gold is 小箱子 (small box), so changed bin to box.
